title: Longest Run of Equal Values
statement: You are given n integers. A run is a block of equal values that sit next to each other. Print the length of the longest run. For example, in 1 1 2 2 2 3 the longest run is 2 2 2, so the answer is 3.
inputFormat: First line: integer n. Second line: n integers separated by spaces.
outputFormat: One integer: the length of the longest run of equal consecutive values.
explanations: The runs are 1 1, then 2 2 2, then 3 3, then 1. The longest has length 3.
All five values are equal, so the whole list is one run of length 5.
reference:
import sys
d = sys.stdin.read().split()
n = int(d[0])
v = d[1:1 + n]
best = 1
cur = 1
for i in range(1, n):
    if int(v[i]) == int(v[i - 1]):
        cur += 1
    else:
        cur = 1
    if cur > best:
        best = cur
print(best)
